patch_description:
The current program uses 4 repair starts, a beam of width 3, 6 ruin rounds, and degree-only greedy saturation. The new configuration replaces repeated matrix-based repair with faster source-derived bitset repairs, expands diversification to 6 input-dependent starts, keeps a width-5 archive, and uses 20 bounded ruin-and-refill exchanges.

The saturation criterion now combines endpoint degree, degree product, and a stronger penalty for degrees above the typical 6--7 range. Removed edges are temporarily banned during refill so that exchanges explore genuinely different local maxima instead of immediately restoring the deleted edges. All additions use the exact bitset length-three-path test, and final matrix verification remains explicit.
